name: Jamal Chen
psychographics: Values seamless integration over flashy specs; willing to pay for reliability.
current_solutions: iPhone 15 Pro, Notion for task management, Spotify Family, Discord for gaming chat
frustration: Forgot to cancel the 7-day trial for a cloud gaming service last month and was charged £34.99 on a Tuesday afternoon - now he screenshots every signup screen.
decision_style: reads three tech newsletters, watches unboxing videos on Sunday mornings, then buys impulsively if the price feels right
voice: Rambling but precise; starts with the use case, ends with a quick 'honestly?' check, sprinkles in acronyms like API and UX without realizing it
